cards.title: Brand Lab
cards.text: Create your own mini brand, design products and make something to take home.
cards.imageAlt: Children printing their own T-shirt designs with a heat press

cards.title: Maker Days
cards.text: Hands-on project days: design a real-world project, build a model with CAD, 3D printers and vinyl cutters, then pitch it to family and friends.
cards.imageAlt: Children building scale models of restaurant designs at Hustle HQ

cards.title: Makers to Market
cards.text: A 12-week programme taking your handmade products from idea to real-world market sales.
cards.imageAlt: Makers selling personalised T-shirts, mugs and 3D-printed gifts at a market stall
